verdict.rationale: Lambda's own Cloud API OpenAPI spec documents outbound webhook notifications sent to a user-supplied URL, but only for support ticket events, not core resource events such as instance launch or termination. The unofficial community tool's Slack/Discord notifications are third-party chat notifications and earn no credit. Missing for 10: webhooks for instance/cluster/billing lifecycle events, documented registration and subscription management, payload, signing and retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Lambda can send webhook notifications to your URL when support ticket events occur, enabling near real-time integration with your systems.
